style.backgroundSystem: one continuous soft winter-morning space: a frosted mist field #DCE4F2 grading into haze #E7E2F3 behind a frosted acrylic pedestal, with warm card panels #FBF6EE carrying the infographic screens; never a hard cyclorama, never concrete, never a graphic hairline grid
style.direction: premium cold-season commuting helmet commerce: a frosted mist set lit by warm window light, so sealed warmth is read as light rather than as claim text
style.iconSystem: flat solid rounded-square glyph tiles with the pictogram knocked out in the card color, uniform corner radius and no outline, fill #5B76A8 with exactly one #F0691C tile per screen; no thin-line circles, no gradient spheres, no long drop shadows
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused warm key from front-left at a low window-light angle, cool ambient bounce from the mist field on the shadow side, one luminous rim tracing the shield edge and the shell parting line, feather-soft contact shadow that always grounds the shell; no hard raking key, no deep falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium cold-season commuting-helmet ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of frosted mist field #DCE4F2, haze panel #E7E2F3, warm card surface #FBF6EE, ink text #333A44, one accent #F0691C and one support tone #5B76A8; warm overall tone; one rounded geometric sans family with the Chinese headline in 「」 and a dotted-border pill annotation strip; one continuous winter-morning background of frosted mist field and frosted acrylic pedestal with warm card panels; soft diffused warm key from front-left at a low window angle, cool ambient bounce on the shadow side, one luminous rim along the shield edge, feather-soft contact shadow grounding the shell on every screen; flat solid rounded-square knock-out glyph icons in #5B76A8 with one #F0691C tile and no thin-line circles or long shadows; the product is always presented as one complete helmet at stable scale and baseline with shield, pivot hardware, padding, strap and buckle intact; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no certification marks, safety-standard codes, test seals, lab wording or report sheets of any kind
no crash, fall, strike, drop or impact-test demonstration; no hammer, falling object, test rig or dropped helmet anywhere in the set
no cracked, dented, scuffed, deformed or otherwise damaged shell or shield
no shell or liner material grade, composition or fibre naming in any rendered copy
no weight, head circumference, size range, dimension arrows, temperature curve, warming-time graph or any protection percentage
no rider shown with the chin strap unfastened, and no loose dangling strap on a worn helmet
no identifiable face, no frontal portrait, no recognisable person
no brand name, shop name, model code, season slogan, watermark, QR code, membership badge or shipping-offer corner mark
no price, discount, coupon, countdown or delivery timing
style.presentationRules: the helmet is always one complete object: shell, single transparent shield, side pivot hardware, lower shell wrap, inner padding, webbing strap and buckle exactly as in the reference; the shell graphic stays on the same side, same scale and same placement on every screen; identical silhouette scale and baseline between screens; the hero stays a front 3/4 reading angle so later angles read as the same product; part names stay generic to the category
style.surfaceSystem: frosted translucent acrylic pedestal and matte warm card surfaces; the shell kept in its own reference finish, real textile pile and stitch rows on the liner, honest refraction and edge specular through the transparent shield
style.typography: one rounded geometric sans family; headline in 「」 at 28-36pt, sub-line 14-16pt, labels 12-14pt, dotted-border pill annotation strip and small corner tick marks; copy is injected as placeholders and composited in post, no dense body text
